name: Encrypted Letter

angles.text: As a rogue, you meet Jorik Kerridan and hear his counsel on dealing with SI:7 and the Defias Brotherhood while keeping your independence.
Even within Northshire Abbey, Stormwind's shadow operatives recruit and train promising agents for the conflicts ahead.

faq.answer: Jorik Kerridan sent the letter, which bears his personal insignia. Promising novices receive it after scouting nearby kobold camps.
Jorik Kerridan stays in the quiet stable behind Northshire Abbey. He keeps out of sight while tending to his covert work.
The letter discreetly invites rising rogues to meet their local trainer. Its encrypted words keep training matters from prying eyes around the Abbey.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Letter?

faq.answer: Jorik Kerridan says many factions seek skilled rogues, including Stormwind's covert agency SI:7 and the Defias Brotherhood. The Defias seek spies inside Stormwind.
faq.q: Which organizations are looking to recruit rogues?

faq.answer: Jorik urges you to remain your own person and refuse to be bullied into work against your will. Rogues hold the cards before the game is done.
faq.q: What advice does Jorik Kerridan give?

faq.answer: Jorik Kerridan stays in the quiet stable behind Northshire Abbey because it draws little attention. There, trainers and operatives can meet beyond the notice of the Abbey's clergy and guards.
faq.q: Why does Jorik Kerridan stay in the stable?

sections.body: Northshire Abbey looks peaceful, yet covert talents are recruited within its walls. After dealing with the kobolds, promising novices receive a letter bearing Jorik Kerridan's seal. It is addressed discreetly, away from the priests and paladins. The bearer is sent to a secluded meeting in the stables behind the Abbey.
sections.title: A Discreet Summons

sections.body: Jorik Kerridan keeps to the stables because they are quiet and draw little notice. When newcomers arrive unseen, he speaks plainly about the wider world. Stormwind's SI:7 and the Defias Brotherhood both seek stealthy operatives. Jorik urges each novice to keep their freedom and resist powerful groups that would push them around. A clever rogue holds the cards.
sections.title: Shadows in Northshire

summary: At Northshire Abbey, Jorik Kerridan summons promising rogues to meet him in secret. His letter points them toward a quiet stable and counsel for the dangers ahead.
